request_summary: Take a read-only before snapshot of the shared issuer table on the corrected storage account, then rerun the GEC suite on DEV.

actions.description: Read the configured issuer table in the three fixture partitions before launching; the request was refused with an authorization permission mismatch, so the runner stopped without starting behave and reported blocked.
The orchestrator reverted the temporary endpoint override.

outcome.detail: The runner stopped correctly at the failed read-only precondition; the table now resolves but the signed-in identity has no data-plane role on it, so no test ran and no remote state changed.

friction.description: The signed-in identity lacks a data-plane role on the AFM storage account table, which blocks any verification of the issuer setup and restore path from this machine.
